headline: AgentOS Kit open-sourced: a Multi-Agent OS for AI software development
summary: AgentOS Kit coordinates specialized AI agents to collaborate on software projects, assigning responsibilities for efficient development workflows.
details: After months of designing AI development workflows, AgentOS Kit has been open-sourced. It functions as a Multi-Agent Operating System, coordinating specialized AI agents to work together on software projects.

This system moves beyond the traditional model of a single AI handling all tasks. Instead, AgentOS Kit assigns specific responsibilities to dedicated agents, aiming to streamline complex software development processes.
caption:
An open-source Multi-Agent Operating System is here to revolutionize AI software development. AgentOS Kit coordinates specialized AI agents for collaborative projects.

After months of designing AI development workflows, AgentOS Kit has been open-sourced. It functions as a Multi-Agent Operating System, coordinating specialized AI agents to work together on software projects.

This system moves beyond the traditional model of a single AI handling all tasks. Instead, AgentOS Kit assigns specific responsibilities to dedicated agents, aiming to streamline complex software development processes.
